caption:
GTA 6's 8 Game Awards nominations, and our honest odds for each 🏆 S = lock, A = likely, B = coin flip.

Our call: 6 of 8. Even a clean sweep can't beat Clair Obscur's record of 9 wins in one night (2025).

The show is Thursday, Dec 10, 7:30 PM ET. Full breakdown on our YouTube, Vice Replay (link in bio). How many does it win? 👇

Nominees: Game Informer, GameSpot, Dexerto, Screen Rant. Record: Guinness World Records, VGC.

Fan page, not affiliated with Rockstar Games.

tips.text: vs 007 First Light, Control Resonant, Phantom Blade Zero, Resident Evil Requiem and Zelda: Ocarina of Time. Our call: lock.

tips.text: vs Ace Combat 8, Mixtape, Phantom Blade Zero and Zelda. Our call: likely.

tips.title: Best Audio Design
tips.text: vs Ace Combat 8, Control Resonant, Resident Evil Requiem and Star Wars: Galactic Racer. Our call: likely.

tips.title: Best Performance
